description: workspace_switch wrote the active workspace id to the KV key 'workspace.active', but every other component reads 'active_space_id' from inside the 'workspaces' JSON blob, so the switch silently failed.
resolution: Already fixed in commit 2d90598d (ship WIP): workspace_switch now mutates active_space_id inside the workspaces blob and no longer writes workspace.active. Covered by test at tool_executor.rs:1897+ which asserts the blob updates and the orphan key is absent.

description: search_code initialized context_after empty and never populated it for non-last matches, silently dropping after-context lines.
resolution: Already fixed in commit 2d90598d: the match handler now retrospectively populates the previous match's context_after from pending_context (search.rs:225-244), with a final flush for the last match. Applied in both search_code and search_files.

description: send_message/read_mailbox silently discarded all unread messages when the mailbox JSON was corrupt (unwrap_or_default).
resolution: Already fixed in commit 2d90598d: both send_message (swarm.rs:234+) and read_mailbox (swarm.rs:309+) now quarantine a corrupt mailbox to a .corrupt sidecar (forensic preservation) before starting fresh, and log a warning. read_mailbox still returns Ok(Vec::new()) on non-NotFound IO errors but now logs them (intentional contract choice).

description: send_anthropic hardcoded the Anthropic API version header '2024-10-22' while one_title_call used the ANTHROPIC_VERSION constant ('2023-06-01'), advertising inconsistent versions to the same API.
resolution: Fixed 2026-08-04: the hardcoded '2024-10-22' header was replaced with the ANTHROPIC_VERSION constant so all Anthropic calls share one version header.

description: A near-verbatim duplicate of the MAX_AGENT_LINE_BYTES doc comment was misplaced directly before the AgentMessageType enum.
resolution: Fixed 2026-08-04: the duplicate comment block was removed; only the canonical comment preceding the const remains.

description: append_output stripped ALL empty lines from any multi-line chunk, destroying paragraph breaks in agent output.
resolution: Already fixed in commit 2d90598d: only the trailing empty element from split('\n') is stripped (guarded by i == last_idx), preserving interior blank lines.
